account_balances_reported_figure.name: account_balances_reported_figure
account_balances_reported_figure.value: available_minor is not null or current_minor is not null

categories_name_trimmed.name: categories_name_trimmed
categories_name_trimmed.value: name = btrim(name) and char_length(name) between 1 and 60

classification_proposals_before_reason_b.name: classification_proposals_before_reason_bounded
classification_proposals_before_reason_b.value: before_category_reason is null or char_length(before_category_reason) between 1 and 200

classification_proposals_state_scope.name: classification_proposals_state_scope
classification_proposals_state_scope.value:
(state in ('proposed', 'skipped', 'conflicted')
          and applied_category_revision is null and applied_updated_at is null)
        or (state in ('applied', 'rolled_back', 'rollback_conflict')
          and applied_category_revision is not null and applied_updated_at is not null)

classification_proposals_revisions_nonne.name: classification_proposals_revisions_nonnegative
classification_proposals_revisions_nonne.value:
before_category_revision >= 0
        and (applied_category_revision is null or applied_category_revision > before_category_revision)

classification_runs_counts_nonnegative.name: classification_runs_counts_nonnegative
classification_runs_counts_nonnegative.value: attempted >= 0 and proposed >= 0 and applied >= 0 and skipped >= 0 and conflicted >= 0

classification_runs_usage_nonnegative.name: classification_runs_usage_nonnegative
classification_runs_usage_nonnegative.value:
(provider_input_tokens is null or provider_input_tokens >= 0)
        and (provider_output_tokens is null or provider_output_tokens >= 0)

classification_runs_identity_bounded.name: classification_runs_identity_bounded
classification_runs_identity_bounded.value:
char_length(requested_model) between 1 and 200
        and (response_model is null or char_length(response_model) between 1 and 200)
        and char_length(prompt_version) between 1 and 100
        and char_length(assignment_schema_version) between 1 and 100
        and (provider_generation_id is null or char_length(provider_generation_id) between 1 and 200)
        and (operator_actor is null or char_length(operator_actor) between 1 and 200)

classification_runs_fingerprints_valid.name: classification_runs_fingerprints_valid
classification_runs_fingerprints_valid.value:
taxonomy_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        and provider_policy_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        and (proposal_set_hash is null or proposal_set_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and (result_set_hash is null or result_set_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

classification_runs_kind_scope.name: classification_runs_kind_scope
classification_runs_kind_scope.value:
(kind = 'automatic_initial' and operator_actor is null and expires_at is null)
        or (kind = 'automatic_reclassification' and operator_actor is not null and expires_at is not null)

classification_runs_status_scope.name: classification_runs_status_scope
classification_runs_status_scope.value:
(kind = 'automatic_initial'
          and status in ('inferring', 'succeeded', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'failed'))
        or (kind = 'automatic_reclassification'
          and status in ('inferring', 'proposed', 'applied', 'partially_applied',
            'rolled_back', 'partially_rolled_back', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'failed'))

recurring_streams_name_bounded.name: recurring_streams_name_bounded
recurring_streams_name_bounded.value: normalized_name = btrim(normalized_name) and char_length(normalized_name) between 1 and 200

transactions_category_source_scope.name: transactions_category_source_scope
transactions_category_source_scope.value: category_id is not null or category_source is null

transactions_auto_fields_scope.name: transactions_auto_fields_scope
transactions_auto_fields_scope.value: (category_confidence is null and category_reason is null) or category_source = 'auto'

transactions_category_reason_bounded.name: transactions_category_reason_bounded
transactions_category_reason_bounded.value: category_reason is null or char_length(category_reason) between 1 and 200

transactions_category_run_scope.name: transactions_category_run_scope
transactions_category_run_scope.value: category_run_id is null or category_source is not distinct from 'auto'
